reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text: I was getting break out and thought I would try this toner as I had heard great reviews. I have used this for a week and my spots are reducing, they are not as irritant prior to using it . Spells of Ttree.i only put it on my cheeks and chin as that’s where the breakout is, let it dry and then use a brightening toner .
reviews.zh: 我之前成日爆瘡，聽到好多好評就試吓呢款toner。我用咗一個星期，瘡開始消，之前冇咁刺激。茶樹嘅味道。我只係搽喺面頰同下巴，因為嗰度先係爆瘡嘅位置，等佢乾咗再用一款提亮toner。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text: To be honest I’ve heard many times that’s AHA BHA PHA it’s really good for acne but I had my questions and wasn’t really sure about it. I tried this toner and I can say that Im seeing a difference this time. And I’ve used SO many toners and brands at this point. I had a bad reaction to something last week and my whole chin was covered with pimples, and now most of them are healed and dried, so I’m really happy with this product.
reviews.zh: 說實話我聽過好多次 AHA BHA PHA 對暗瘡真係好有用，但我一直有啲疑問，唔太確定。我試咗呢款爽膚水，可以講呢次我真係睇到分別。我到呢個階段已經用過好多好多爽膚水同品牌。上星期我因為某啲嘢反應成塊下巴都長滿暗瘡，而家大部分已經退咗、結咗痂，所以對呢款產品我真係好滿意。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text: A repurchase. At night, it’s not too strong where it gives me a breakout the day after or makes your skin feel dry from stripping it from moisture. In the morning, it provides a gentle exfoliation to prep a really clean base for makeup application. I prefer to only use it either in the morning if I’m wearing makeup or just at night if I didn’t wear any. I use it with a cotton pad to ensure I’m getting dead skin cells or any other gunk off my face and neck that I missed while cleansing. I have noticed less breakouts and some dark spots fading since using, but gradually. You have to keep using it to notice a major difference.
reviews.zh: 回購。晚上用，唔會太強而令我第二日爆瘡，又唔會抽走皮膚水分搞到乾燥。早上用，就可以溫和去角質，幫之後化妝打好個底。我比較鍾意要嘛化妝嗰朝用，要嘛夜晚冇化妝就用。我會用化妝棉，確保抹走沖涼時冇清到嘅死皮或者污糟嘢，塊面同條頸都會抹。自從用咗之後，暗瘡少咗，啲暗斑都慢慢淡咗，但要持續用先見到明顯分別。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text: This is my favorite exfoliating toner I’ve tried. I have very clog prone skin that tends to get worse in the summer and this has really helped control my closed comedones and sebum production. I use it about 2-3 times a week when my face needs a little extra help, but I do think it’s light enough to use everyday.
reviews.zh: 係我試過最鍾意嘅去角質爽膚水。我皮膚超容易塞毛孔，夏天仲會嚴重啲，呢支真係幫到我控制閉口粉刺同皮脂分泌。我一星期用大概 2-3 次，塊面需要額外幫手嘅時候就用，但我覺得佢都夠溫和可以日日用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text: This toner works wonders on my skin. The combination of AHA, BHA, and PHA effectively exfoliates dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and helps reduce breakouts. Despite its powerful exfoliating properties, the toner is surprisingly gentle. It doesn’t cause any irritation or redness, making it suitable for my sensitive skin. It also contains tea tree extract, which helps soothe and calm the skin. The scent is mild and refreshing, which I really appreciate as it doesn't feel overwhelming.
reviews.zh: 呢支爽膚水對我塊面效果好神奇。AHA、BHA 同 PHA 嘅組合有效去走死皮、疏通毛孔、幫助減少爆瘡。雖然去角質能力咁強，但爽膚水出奇地溫和，唔會刺激又唔會泛紅，啱晒我嘅敏感肌。佢仲有茶樹萃取，可以舒緩鎮靜皮膚。味道好淡好清新，我真係好鍾意，因為唔會覺得頂唔順。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner Special Set (150mL+30mL)
reviews.text: I was a bit scared to try this since I saw mixed reviews in tiktok but I had a fresh pimple when I tried this in PM routine and when I woke up the next day the pimple shrunk and it wasnt inflamed anymore! Literally a miracle toner! Came with a smaller bottle to great for travel!
reviews.zh: 本來有啲驚試，因為喺 TikTok 見到好壞參半嘅評論，但我夜晚護膚程序試緊嘅時候啱啱生咗一粒新暗瘡，聽日朝早起身嗰粒瘡縮咗又唔再發炎！真係奇蹟爽膚水！仲送咗支細枝裝，好啱去旅行！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner Special Set (150mL+30mL)
reviews.text:
I use this along with the Acne clear foam wash, and since using it has made a considerable difference. I have less spots now, i do flare up every now and again due to hormones but i do feel that my skin is refreshed and moisturised having this in my toner regime.
The travel bottles are also convienent
reviews.zh:
我配合埋暗瘡泡沫潔面一齊用，自從用咗之後有明顯分別。暗瘡少咗，雖然有時侯因為荷爾蒙都會翻發，但用咗呢支爽膚水之後皮膚感覺清爽又保濕。
旅行裝都好方便。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI AHA.BHA.PHA 30 Days Miracle Toner 150ml
reviews.text:
반신반의하고 샀는데 넘 만족합니다. 블랙헤드는 잘 모르겠는데 각질에 막혀있는 피지 -화이트헤드- 는 정말정말 거의 없어졌어요. 저는 각질피부라서 아침 저녁으로 사용해요. 아마존에서 파는 제일 얇은 화장솜 있어요 1000장에 10불정도하는.. 거기에 적셔서 피부결따라 살살 닦아주고 화이트헤드 많은 턱밑에는 조금 더 문질문질합니다. 효과좋아요. 화이트헤드 고민이신분들은 후회안하실거..
It's been about two weeks that I started this toner. I have so many bumps on my skin (white heads) all over the skin. Now those are almost disappearing. It does not remove scars or correct skin tone. I know I should not touch my face with my dirty fingers but I just keep touching because it is so smooth now. This is the toner type that you must use with a cotton pads. Try to get thin pads to use the bottle longer!
